Tempered water shall be delivered from lavatories and group wash fixtures located in public toilet facilities provided for customers, patrons and visitors. Tempered water shall be delivered through an approved water-temperature limiting device that conforms to ASSE 1070.
   Exception: Where point of use heaters are installed, outlet water temperature shall be regulated to provide tempered water.
Section PC 417: Showers
